source_caption:
🎬 Big Stan (2007)

Big Stan follows Stan Minton, a wealthy and arrogant real estate con artist whose comfortable lifestyle comes crashing down when he is convicted of fraud and sentenced to prison. Terrified of what might happen to him behind bars, Stan hires a mysterious martial arts expert known as The Master to teach him how to defend himself. Through intense and hilarious training sessions, Stan transforms from a frightened businessman into a surprisingly skilled fighter. When he finally enters prison, his newfound abilities quickly earn him respect among the inmates, but his experiences also begin changing the way he sees himself and others. Starring Rob Schneider, David Carradine, and Jennifer Morrison, the film delivers outrageous comedy, entertaining martial arts action, and unexpected heartfelt moments while exploring courage, friendship, personal growth, and the importance of standing up for others.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Action • Crime

⭐ IMDb: 6.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 45m • R

🎥 Director: Rob Schneider

✍️ Writer: Josh Lieb

source_details.synopsis: Big Stan is a 2007 American martial arts prison comedy film starring, produced, and directed by Rob Schneider in his directorial debut with help from his company From Out of Nowhere Productions. The rest of the cast includes Jennifer Morrison, Scott Wilson, Henry Gibson, Richard Kind, Sally Kirkland, Jackson Rathbone, M. Emmet Walsh, Dan Haggerty, and David Carradine. It tells the story of a real estate con artist who gets sentenced to three years in prison and spends the six months beforehand getting trained by a martial arts guru to survive in prison.
